value.rationale: The number of rational points outside all geometric exceptional curves is a motivated finite-field cubic-surface invariant, used when choosing rational base points for geometric constructions and unirationality. The closed formula for an entire nonsplit congruence family distinguishes the unique q=7 zero locus and proves positive off-line counts for every other admissible q. It is not an arbitrary one-field enumeration.
